properties.name: SS Thistlegorm Wreck
properties.region: Red Sea - Straits of Gubal (Sha'ab Ali)
properties.description_en: World-famous British WWII cargo ship sunk in 1941 by German bombers. Holds fully laden with Bedford trucks, BSA motorbikes, train locomotives, and munitions.
properties.description_it: Il relitto più famoso al mondo: mercantile britannico affondato nel 1941 con le stive intatte piene di moto BSA, autocarri Bedford, vagoni ferroviari e ali di caccia.

properties.name: Giannis D Wreck
properties.description_en: Greek cargo ship struck Abu Nuhas reef in 1983. Sits at a 45-degree angle with a remarkably photogenic bridge, engine room, and A-frame mast covered in glassfish.
properties.description_it: Mercantile greco naufragato nel 1983 sulla scogliera di Abu Nuhas. Inclinato a 45 gradi, famoso per la timoneria fotogenica e la sala macchine colonizzata da coralli.

properties.name: Dahab Blue Hole & The Arch
properties.description_en: Submarine sinkhole dropping over 100m straight down into deep blue water. The Saddle (7m) and outer coral wall are superb recreational dives, while The Arch (56m) is technical.
properties.description_it: Spettacolare dolina sottomarina circolare che sprofonda oltre 100m. La sella corallina a 7m e la parete esterna offrono immersioni ricreative indimenticabili.

properties.name: Shark & Yolanda Reef
properties.region: Red Sea - Ras Mohammed National Park
properties.description_en: Two coral pinnacles connected by a saddle dropping to 800m. World-class drift dive with pelagic sharks, massive schools of snappers, and the quirky Yolanda toilet wreck.
properties.description_it: Pinnacoli corallini che precipitano negli abissi a 800m all'estremità del Sinai. Squali grigi, enormi caroselli di carangidi e il carico di sanitari del relitto Yolanda.
